transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: ok so, can everyone see the screen? that's the gantry fixture, rev two

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: I see it. Walk us through the changes since last review.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: so the big one is the side rails, we went from the extrusion to a bent plate, uh, because the extrusion was flexing under the ankle load

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: How much flex are we talking?

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: like a millimeter at full load, which blows up the angle measurement

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Okay, that's too much.

transcript.speaker: p-diego
transcript.text: Yeah, plus the harness routing, I moved the pass-through 40 mm toward the back 🙏 so the cable stops rubbing the shank

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: do we have the bend radius for the plate, i dont want to crack it

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: it's on the drawing, i'll send you the link. i think it's fine for the thickness we picked

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: ok ty *thx

transcript.speaker: p-kenji
transcript.text: whats the load path on the pelvis mount

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: it goes through the two m10 bolts into the base plate, then to the floor anchors

transcript.speaker: p-kenji
transcript.text: and the anchors are rated for that

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: carlos knows better than me

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: The anchors are fine. We pulled test on them last spring. I'd double the washers though.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Put that in the notes. Washers.

transcript.speaker: p-diego
transcript.text: Round of updates from my side: the foot plate drawing is released, the ankle adapter is being cut, and I'm still waiting on the cable carrier drawing from the vendor 😬

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Who's the vendor on that?

transcript.speaker: p-diego
transcript.text: The usual one, I'll dig up the thread after this

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: ok next the load cells. we have two on the fixture now, one in the foot, one at the hip. the hip one drifts with temp, uh, like a lot

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Does it need a thermal compensation, or do we just warm it up?

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: warming up for ten minutes gets most of it. the sensor guy said, uh, don't trust the first run of the day

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: That's true for the dyno too.

transcript.speaker: p-kenji
transcript.text: could we log temp next to it

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: yeah, thermocouple's cheap, i'll add one

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: oh also, Battery enclosure thermal runaway containment, that moved from the 7th to 11/4

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Okay. Noted.

transcript.speaker: p-diego
transcript.text: Noted 🙏

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Let's talk safety. E-stop on the gantry, where is it now?

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: right side, at hip height. carlos wants a second one at the rear

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Yes, YES. Two E-stops, one each side. Not negotiable!!

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Agreed. Add a second one.

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: ill add it to the build list

transcript.speaker: p-kenji
transcript.text: what about the cable tray

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: that's the thing we said we'd deal with last. nxt wk probably

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Okay, I think we're done. Zoe, send the updated drawings out by EOW.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: ok, thurs or fri, one of them

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Thanks, everyone.

summary.overview: Review of the gantry test fixture, rev two. Changes were rails, harness pass-through, load cells, safety.
shorthand_bullet: side rails changed from extrusion to bent plate, extrusion flexed about 1 mm at full load
harness pass-through moved toward the back
pelvis mount load path through two M10 bolts, double washers suggested
hip load cell drifts with temp, warm up ten min, add thermocouple
Battery enclosure thermal runaway containment moved to 11/4
second E-stop to be added at rear
cable carrier drawing still pending from vendor
action_items: zoe to send updated drawings by EOW
luis to add second E-stop to build list
zoe to add thermocouple at hip load cell
diego to chase cable carrier drawing
